title: Adversarial Learning Game for Intrusion Detection in Quantum Key Distribution
summary: While Quantum Key Distribution (QKD) provides information-theoretic security, the transition from theory to physical hardware introduces side-channel vulnerabilities that traditional error metrics often fail to characterize. This paper presents a high-fidelity simulation framework for intrusion detection in decoy-state QKD, modeled as a minimax game between a learning-based defender and a physically constrained, adaptive adversary.
